contract_term.quote: Provide ongoing Software support and consulting of the PuWorks and ESTI ArcGIS for a period of two (2) years.

scope_of_deliverables.quote: The Villages are requesting responses to select a consultant to both implement and update data within the Villages Asset Management Software (AMS), consisting of Munisoft PubWorks and ESRI ArcGIS. The primary task of the contractor is to improve the functionality and ease of use of the AMS through a hands on approach. The Villages are open to other recommendations on expanding the functionality and improving integration of the AMS.
scope_of_deliverables.value: Implement and update data within the Villages Asset Management Software (AMS), consisting of Munisoft PubWorks and ESRI ArcGIS, to improve functionality and ease of use.

mandatory_submission_requirements.quote:
1. Submission Form (Appendix B) Each quotation must include a Submission Form (Appendix B) completed and signed by an authorized representative of the respondent.
2. Pricing (Appendix C) Each quotation must include pricing information that complies with the instructions contained in Pricing (Appendix C). Proponents are encouraged to view the proposed locations before submission of pricing. Use Bid Form attached as a separate document (Annex B).
3. Other Mandatory Submission Requirements Evidence of Safety Program and Insurance Upon notice of intent to negotiate, the Proponent will be required to supply: A valid copy of a current WCB clearance letter with the executed contract and with each invoice submitted for payment. Provide evidence of an active safety program such as providing a valid copy of an Alberta Certificate of Recognition (COR or SECOR or other Industry Partner certificate) or other evidence of an active workplace safety program. A valid certificate of insurance with coverage not less than Two (2) Million dollars from an insurance company legally capable of carrying on business within the province of Alberta, names the Village as an additional insured with cross liability, and provides an minimum 30 days notice of any changes to the policy. Both WCB and Insurance documentation MUST indicate coverage for the type of work being requested in this competition and carried out in the resulting agreement.

pricing_structure.quote: Pricing is worth 35 points of the total score. The Proponent submitting the lowest price shall receive the full point value available for the price score. All other Proponent pricing shall be divided into the lowest compliant price received in order to obtain the ratio. That ratio shall be used to determine the points to be allocated to the submission.
